mechanism: submit() success-check FALSE NEGATIVE on a SUCCESSFUL submission: the check compared the first submissions-list line starting with the literal 'submission' before vs after the submit call. Three composed fragilities: (1) the startswith('submission') match is a CLI-output-format dependency that returns '' under other formats; (2) the 'after' read races submissions-list API lag with ZERO retries; (3) ''=='' collapses the before!=after test to False. Result: submission 55656892 was ACCEPTED by Kaggle (verified PENDING on the list with the full A21 message) while the daemon logged ok=false with empty tails, exited 1, and LEFT THE FIRED HEAD QUEUED - the double-fire landmine.
context: Manual coordinator run of daily_submit.py at 00:31Z (UTC-day quota unused after the earlier preflight-block incident, exp 27). Every gate held: the re-tagged head passed trusted-fork preflight ALLOW. Only the post-submit verification lied.
recovery: Coordinator reconciled by hand: head moved to history with submitted_at 00:31:23Z and an explicit manual-reconcile note; manual-reconcile event appended to submission_log.jsonl; queue reduced to [filler]. Graft-lane agent verified the submission from the SOURCE OF TRUTH (competitions submissions list: 55656892 PENDING, full A21 message) and confirmed the reconciled queue/log parse clean.
fix_staged: ID/row-based verification in the proposed daemon (same reviewed deploy as the fall-through): parse the CSV (-v) submissions list into full data rows; set-difference before/after with up to 6 reads over ~75s (API-lag tolerant); message-token match on NEW rows, with new-row+CLI-success-marker corroboration for truncated descriptions; if the CLI reports success but the list never shows the row, TRUST THE CLI and pop the head (a queued already-submitted head is the proven double-fire landmine) while logging a loud submit-listlag-assumed-ok warning for the morning check; CLI failure with no new row remains a failure. 9/9 synthetic scenarios pass incl. tonight's exact ''=='' trap; the fall-through suite (23 checks incl. the inverse guard) still passes; cosmetic nit fixed in the same touch.
lesson: VERIFY FROM THE SOURCE OF TRUTH, NOT A PROXY DIFF: a success check built on string-diffing a format-dependent proxy fails CLOSED in the wrong direction - it converts success into failure and leaves state that fires twice. The robust shape is: durable IDs, set-difference, retries for lag, and an explicit precedence rule for conflicting signals (CLI says yes, list says nothing) chosen by comparing the COSTS of the two errors (double-fire beats lost-draw here). Second lesson, standing: the failure surfaced only because a human asked why nothing was running - the ok=false log line LOOKED like diligence; a verification that can lie in one direction needs its own verification.
why_informative: Second submission-rail reliability row in 24h, composing with exp 27: the preflight-block incident proved the rail can refuse to fire; this one proves it can fire and DENY having fired. Both defects were latent for weeks and surfaced only when the first non-filler head in six days exercised paths the filler never did - registering that pattern (new artifact classes exercise dormant code paths; instrument the first traversal) is the row's chief value beyond the specific fix.
